info.title: VetLink API
info.description: REST API for the VetLink mobile and web apps. USSD, SMS and M-Pesa webhooks are not part of this document. Errors are `{ code, message_key, details }`; `message_key` maps into the shared i18n package.

post.summary: Get a URL to upload a file straight to private storage
post.description:
Access: any signed-in user.

PUT the file to `uploadUrl` with `headers`, then confirm it: vet documents with POST /v1/vets/me/application/documents (vet role), avatars with PUT /v1/me/avatar, animal photos with PUT /v1/animals/:id/photo (farmer role). Photos must be re-encoded on the device (drops EXIF) and be at most 500 KB.

put.summary: Set my profile photo (after uploading it)
put.description:
Access: any signed-in user.

A farmer's photo is live at once. A vet's new photo waits for a verifier (`photo.review`); farmers keep seeing the approved one. Safe to retry.

post.description:
Access: role `farmer`.

Idempotent per farmer and `Idempotency-Key`: a retry returns the same booking with 200; the same key with a different request is 422. The fee is always quoted by the server.

patch.summary: Change prices and practice details (approved vets; applied immediately)
patch.description:
Access: role `vet`.

Prices must stay within the admin bands, every offered service needs a price, and at least one of call-outs or premises. Critical details (name, ID, KVB, licence, payout) go through a reviewed new application version instead.

post.summary: Pay the booking deposit: sends an M-Pesa prompt to my phone
post.description:
Access: role `farmer`.

Returns the in-flight or already-paid deposit instead of sending a second prompt. The amount is set by the server. Poll the payment or the booking for the result; the client never marks a payment successful.
